error: x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-ld: cannot find -lcuda: No such file or directory
cause: The compiler's link search paths do not contain an unversioned libcuda.so. The offline installation has no CUDA driver development stub.

environment_correction.runtime_loader: Do not put stubs on LD_LIBRARY_PATH; execution uses the real NVIDIA driver.

failure_cache_policy: TEMPER retains failure caches for diagnosis within the allocation's temporary namespace. Necessary compiler diagnostics were saved in shared job logs and summarized here. Subsequent jobs create fresh caches; they do not assume access to the previous job's /tmp. Scratch lifetime after allocation is controlled by the scheduler.
